ModMetaData.name: Reconstructive Surgery
ModMetaData.author: lemonade
ModMetaData.description:
Adds mid-tier reconstructive surgery for permanent scars: scar revision, tissue grafting, malunion correction, facial reconstruction, and cosmetic contouring, plus a one-click planner that queues every needed operation. Fresh wounds still heal by tending; missing parts and internal organ scars stay for serum, biosculpter, or bionics.
Requires Harmony.
Optional integration with Scars and Beauty: when that mod is active, surgeries additionally consume Insectamed / Insectogel, Collagenesis, and Agavecine.
